Data Sources

Drop spreadsheets or Kraken2 reports here Or click to choose files
ASV data: Wilder_01 (.xlsx metadata/aggregated/full) · Wilder_02 (Samples + Taxa) · Ocean DNA Explorer (table_*.tsv + asvTaxaFeatures_*.tsv, with the FAIRe sampleMetadata / experimentRunMetadata .tsv — or use “Import from Ocean DNA Explorer” above) · Kraken2 reports (.kraken2.report / .txt — one per sample; you’ll pick which sample each belongs to) · Station metadata: MBON_Data (.xlsx with sampleMetadata). Load metadata + data together for station mapping.
Uploads overwrite any already-loaded sample with the same sample ID (FAIRe template → that sample’s metadata; ASV / Kraken2 report → that sample’s reads). Use Reset to original below to undo.
